definitions: The ability to make wise choices or decisions.

blocks.text: Discretion is the power or right to decide or act according to one's own judgment, freedom of judgment or choice. In a broader social context, it refers to the quality of being discreet, encompassing the ability to behave or speak in such a way as to avoid causing offense or revealing private information.
Discretion is an upcoming American legal thriller created by Chandler Baker, from her short story of the same name. It stars Elle Fanning and Nicole Kidman who are both executive producers.
